name: SikaTile-374 Mega Pro
paste:
SIKATILE®-374 MEGA PRO: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaTile®-374 Mega Pro, March 2025, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/e/sikatile-374-megapro.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaTile®-374 Mega Pro where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2025, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. SikaTile®-374 Mega Pro is a fine white, polymer fortified, flexible, sand and silica free cement-based tile adhesive, suitable for tile and stone internal wall tiling applications.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - SikaTile®-374 Mega Pro is suitable for fixing tile and stone by thin bed application for internal applications.
    - SUITABLE TILE TYPES ARE;
    - • Ceramic Tiles
    - • Porcelain Tiles
    - • Natural Stone (non moisture sensitive stone)
    - • Manufactured Stone (non moisture sensitive stone) • Mosaics
    - SUITABLE SUBSTRATES INCLUDE;
    - • Concrete (concrete greater than 35Mpa compressive strength requires mechanical preparation)
    - • Compressed Cement Boards*
    - • Ceramic Tile underlay / Fibre Cement boards*
    - • Cement-baseds renders
    - • Sika approved under tile waterproof membranes
    - • Cement renders
    - • Gypsum Plasterboard
    - *refer to board manufacturers instructions for further details and load limits.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.9.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaTile®-374 Mega Pro
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: A FINE WHITE POLYMER FORTIFIED FLEXIBLE SAND AND SILICA FREE CEMENT-BASED WALL TILE ADHESIVE
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (March 2025, Version 01.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS ISO 13007: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Product declaration (p.1).
    - AS 3958:2023: referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Application Instructions > APPLICATION (p.3); Application Instructions > RENDERS: (p.3); Application Instructions > SUBSTRATE QUALITY (p.2); Further Documentation (p.2).
    - AS3958:2023: referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Application Instructions > APPLICATION (p.3).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Sand & Silica free formulation
    - White colour suitable for light and opaque stone (not sensitive to moisture)
    - Fine, smooth trowelable consistency
    - S1 Flexible performance
    - Internal wall applications only
    - Suitable over Sika under tile waterproofing membranes
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Fine white powder
    - Product declaration: C1TES1 as per AS ISO 13007
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: Low VOC - 13g/L
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 20kg bags / 64 bags per pallet
    - Shelf life: If unopened 12 months from date of manufacture
    - Storage conditions: Store in dry cool conditions, elevated out of direct sunlight

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2025, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality.
    - All substrates shall meet minimum deflection standards outlined in the Australian Standards AS 3958:2023
    - All substrates shall be free from loose friable materials, dust, debris, release agents, curing compounds, grease, sealers and other contaminating materials. Contaminated substrates must be mechanically prepared to expose at least 80% of the original substrate.
    - For substrates that require a levelling compound use a suitable Sika® faring coat /skim coat.
3.3 Substrate quality - Concrete substrates. New concrete shall be cured for 28 days and be left with a wood float finish. Steel trowel finished concrete is generally acceptable if the concrete allows water penetration. Concrete above 35Mpa shall be mechanically prepared.
3.4 Substrate quality - Cement boards and sheeting. All boards and sheets must be fixed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions and specifically designed for tiling.
3.5 Substrate quality - Renders. Cement-based renders must be installed as per AS 3958:2023 and left for a minimum 24 hours prior to tiling. Renders may need longer drying time in cold climtes.
3.6 Substrate preparation. Substrates shall be primed prior to adhesive application.
3.7 Substrate preparation - Porous substrates can be primed with.
    - SikaTile 010 Secure Prime
    - Davco Ultraprime
    - Davco PrimeX
    - SikaTile 015 Prep n Prime
    Non Porous Substrates can be primed with:
3.8 Substrate preparation - Note.
    - Refer to the specific product data sheet for the complete user instructions prior to use.
    - Do not apply primers over waterproofing membranes.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2025, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: 6.5 - 7 Litres of clean, cool potable water per 20kg bag
    - Pot Life: 2.5 hours
    - Open Time: 30 Minutes
    - Adjustability time: 20 minutes
4.3 Consumption.
    | Notched trowel size | Approximate coverage per bag |
    | 6mm | 9.5m² |
    | 10mm | 6m² |
    | Consumption is dependant of surface profile, and application technique. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.4 Applied product ready for use.
    | USE | WAIT TIME |
    | Grouting on walls | 12 hours |
    | Dry area service | 24 hours |
    | Wet area service | 5 days |
    | All application information date is determined at laboratory conditions: 23°C & 50% RH. |
    | Higher temperatures will reduce times and lower temperatures with increase times. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.5 Equipment.
    - Personal protective equipment
    - Mixing Buckets
    - Mixing drill with stirring attachment
    - Trowels
4.6 Mixing.
    - Pour clean cool water into a mixing bucket and gradually pour the the SikaTile®-374 Mega Pro powder into the bucket and stir with a mixing drill).
    - Mix for 2-3 minutes to a smooth lump free homogeneous consistency.
    - Allow the product to stand (slake) for 5 minutes then restir for an additional minute.
    - Do not add more water.
    - Restirring the mixture may be required during the adhesives pot life.
4.7 Application.
    - Tiles shall be fixed in accordance to with AS 3958:2023
    - Ensure the backs of tiles are clean and free from dust and contaminates.
    - Apply the adhesive to the substrate with the appropriate sized notched trowel to achieve coverage requirement on both substrate and the back of the tile.
    - Tiles may require back-buttering to achieve minimum coverage requirements.
    - Apply the adhesive with a notched trowel in a single direction.
    - Apply the tile, while pressing into the wet adhesive, break the ridges with the tile to fully bed the tile into the adhesive.
    - It is advisable to periodically check the backs of the tiles for adhesive coverage requirements as the AS3958:2023.
    - Only apply as must adhesive that can be covered prior to adhesive skinning. If skinning occurs remove and replace with fresh adhesive.
    - Remove any excess adhesive from the face of the tile with a damp sponge and ensure grout joint are of uniform depth.
    - Movement, expansion and control joints must be installed as per AS 3958:2023.
    - Allow adhesive to dry prior to grouting.
4.8 Cleaning of equipment. Tools and equipment can be cleaned with water while the adhesive is still wet.
4.9 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Test in an inconspicious area first.
    - Not suitable for applications over tongue and groved timber flooring, plywood, medium density fibre board, or masonite.
    - Not suitable for moisture sensitive stone installations
    - Not suitable to be applied directly over solvent based waterproof membranes.
    - The performance of cement based adhesives will be comprimised when used above 35°C and under 5°C.
    - Due to external influences beyond our control Efflorescence is beyond the control of the manufacturer.
    - Not suitable for external applications
    - Not suitable in submersed applications such as pools or spas.
    - Contact Sika Australia for applications not mentioned in this document or if further information is required.
4.10 Further documentation. Use product in accordance with Australian Standards AS 3958:2023 The Installation of Ceramic & Stone Tiles. It is essential to plan the area to be tiled, with inclusion of movement joints, in accordance with the relevant Australian Standard . Failure to do so may result in drummy or lifting tiles. Make sure normal building or surface movement is accommodated by installing movement joints as follows:
    - Over movement joints in the substrate
    - At a junction between different substrate materials
    - At fixtures interrupting the tile surface e.g. columns
    - At internal vertical corners
    - Around the perimeter of the tiling system
    - At a maximum of 4.5m centres, in a grid pattern
    - Movement joints should be kept free from dirt and adhesive
    - All movement joints can be filled with a suitable Sika sealnt and suitable backing rod or backing tape.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.9):
    - Not suitable for moisture sensitive stone installations
    - The performance of cement based adhesives will be comprimised when used above 35°C and under 5°C.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaTile®-374 Mega Pro, March 2025, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/e/sikatile-374-megapro.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SikaTile 374 Mega PRO, version 30/04/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/8/MSDS%20SikaTile-374%20Mega%20PRO%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaTile®-374 Mega Pro, version 13/04/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/h/sds-sikatile-374megapro.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
